title: Spanning-Tree Maximization Forces Isoperimetry in the Square Lattice
abstract: Lean formalization of spanning-tree maximization over finite connected induced subgraphs of the square lattice. The development establishes edge isoperimetry of every maximizer, the maximum count and all maximizing lattice-isometry classes at every positive cardinality, and uniqueness of the canonical corner-strip domain for N >= 18. Nonuniqueness occurs exactly at N = 3, 8, 10, 13; the canonical count has exceptions at N = 7, 14, 17. It also establishes the sharp square-cardinality stability inequality, an exact scalar product formula and rational recurrence for corner-strip counts, the global extremal asymptotic expansion with O(N^(-1/2)) remainder, and the appendix's exact strip-energy Fourier identity, rectangular remainders, Green estimates, and explicit bounds.
